text:
Aisha (Sales): Quick handoff for Celestia Health — contract signed this morning. Key items: pilot in 3 weeks, target private deployment after pilot. Committed tier: Dedicated-45k/mo. Renewal window: 2026-02-15. Primary customer contacts: Priya (IT), Ben (PM). They flagged two items during procurement: Okta SAML mapping and nightly batch latency concerns. Asking CS to run kickoff and coordinate with support/eng for technical validation.

Diego (CS): Picking this up. Current status I have: tenant provisioned, billing validated, API keys deployed to their dev org. Initial smoke run on hosted shows ~95% success on sample flows. Overall onboarding ~60%.

Diego (CS): Blockers noted from procurement call:
- SAML attribute mismatch (they send `emailAddress` instead of `NameID`).
- Nightly batch takes longer than their SLA; sample ingestion of 2M rows averaged 3.5h.

Lena (Support): I'll open a ticket for the SAML mismatch and tag as onboarding-critical. @Priya can you paste the SAML metadata or an Okta app export? Also, do they need Just-In-Time provisioning?

Priya (Celestia): We can export app metadata and share. No JIT provisioning for now, they just need email mapping and group attribute mapping. I'll DM the export.

Noah (Eng): For the nightly batch latency — can we get the ETL job config (chunk size, concurrency) and a sample payload? If they're sending large nested JSONs we may be CPU-bound in parsing stage. Possible short-term mitigation is to enable compression and increase parallel workers on Dedicated nodes.

Aisha (Sales): They prefer a short technical sync Friday 11am PT. Can CS/eng/support join? Wants to review SAML mapping and batch optimization options.

Diego (CS): I'll set the call. Proposed owners and SLAs: 
- SAML mapping validation: Lena (Support) owner, 48h to validate once metadata received.
- Batch performance triage: Noah (Eng) owner, 72h to provide root cause and mitigation after sample & job config.
- Kickoff & pilot success criteria: Diego (CS) owner, draft by EOD tomorrow.

Lena (Support): Ticket #SUP-3307 created. Notes: expected SAML attributes (our side): NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups. Ask Priya to confirm attribute names and example assertion.

Noah (Eng): Suggested temporary config changes we can propose on the call: increase ingestion concurrency to 8, enable gzip on payloads, and add a tolerant field coercion pass for mismatched types. Can prototype a transformer in ~48h.

Diego (CS): Also capturing enablement: Celestia's PM wants a 45-min walkthrough on observability (how to read token-level billing, tail latency, and traces). I'll schedule a session for week after pilot start.

Aisha (Sales): Renewal signal: they negotiated a 12-month term. Risk at signing low, but if nightly SLA isn't met during pilot, upsell/renewal posture could be affected. Recommend weekly health checks during pilot.

Diego (CS): Agreed. Weekly checkpoints: metrics to monitor — ingestion throughput, median tail latency (95th), error rate, and active seat usage. I'll create a simple dashboard and share.

Priya (Celestia): FYI, the ETL team will send a sanitized sample payload and job config by COB today. Also, they want a short playbook for common misconfigs.

Lena (Support): Thanks Priya — will use sample to validate attribute mapping. If we need a mapping shim we can provide one-off transform.

Noah (Eng): Once I have sample, I'll run a local profiler and post logs here. If transformer required, will open PR and demo on the call.

ops-bot: NOTE: Created onboarding-template checklist for Celestia under onboarding/celestia-2051234567 and added reminder for weekly health reports.

Diego (CS): Next actions (owners/due):
1) Priya: send SAML metadata + sanitized payload (due COB today)
2) Lena: validate SAML mapping and update #SUP-3307 (due 48h)
3) Noah: analyze payload & job config, propose mitigations (due 72h after sample)
4) Diego: schedule Friday 11am PT technical sync + draft pilot success criteria doc (due tomorrow EOD)
5) Aisha: keep sales looped on pilot health, escalate if SLA risk appears (ongoing)

Aisha (Sales): I'll nudge Priya now. Please keep updates in this thread so we don't scatter context. :thumbsup:

Priya (Celestia): Uploaded metadata and a sample to the shared drive. Link: https://share.example.com/celestia/saml-and-sample (priv). ETA for full ETL config: EOD.

Diego (CS): Received. I'll confirm calendar invite once I sync with eng/support. Thanks everyone — I'll post meeting notes and the pilot metrics doc after the sync. :white_check_mark:
